families.name: Form section
families.summary: fh-panel-section--form. A section where a person edits the record in place: one form with one fieldset of Firehorse fields (fh-money included, and fh-panel-section__slot for a field the host supplies), then the actions row. A section whose slot holds a field that renders its own form uses <div class="fh-panel-section__form" role="group" aria-labelledby="…"> as its body instead of the form: never put a form inside a form. A field's read only value, such as "ends in 4f2a", goes in its hint. States are markup only: data-dirty on the section is changed, aria-busy on the form with the save button disabled is saving, one fh-status in the actions row is saved (or an error that belongs to no field), fh-field__error is a field error, and a disabled fieldset with a one line note above it is locked. sidecar.js sets data-dirty on the section and the sidecar; a dirty sidecar fires a cancelable fh:sidecar-before-close before it closes or swaps record. The actions stack under 36rem.
